video_title: Dinners With DeMar - Ep. 8: Kendall Ellis

quotes.speaker: Kendall Ellis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendall Ellis on the academic and athletic balance at USC
quotes.excerpt: they hold both in such high regard they want you to get the best GPA

text_blocks.speaker: Kendall Ellis
text_blocks.text: What really attracted me to USC was that academic and athletic combination. They hold both in such high regard. They want you to get the best GPA and they also want you to win all the championships.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: And not to be biased or anything, we both went there, so it definitely is. I definitely felt the same way going there, being from LA too.

quotes.social_post: Kendall Ellis on choosing USC for the balance of academics and athletics: They hold both in such high regard. They want you to get the best GPA and they also want you to win all the championships.

quotes.speaker: Kendall Ellis
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan on the self-confidence basketball gave him as a child
quotes.excerpt: basketball always gave me self-confidence, especially when I felt like I could be good

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: You getting in track at a very young age. I know for me, basketball always gave me self-confidence, especially when I felt like I could be good. It gave me imagination to be my favorite players.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendall Ellis
text_blocks.text: I don't even think I realized it. I think I was just a six-year-old, seven-year-old having fun, doing like, I want to play tag at recess, and it's cool that like I win.

quotes.social_post: DeMar DeRozan reflects on his childhood: Basketball always gave me self-confidence, especially when I felt like I could be good. It gave me imagination to be my favorite players.

quotes.speaker: Kendall Ellis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendall Ellis on the importance of a strong support system
quotes.excerpt: having a really strong support system of people who aren't involved in the sport

text_blocks.speaker: Kendall Ellis
text_blocks.text: What's helped is developing relationships outside of the sport, which seems counteractive, but I think having a really strong support system of people who aren't involved in the sport, building a team around you of like a good coach, a good chiropractor, a good massage therapist, a weight room coach, and those are your teammates in this at the end of the day.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: Those moments where training is hard, it's really difficult when it's by yourself, but those moments of like, this is what you signed up for and this is what it's going to take, and so you're going to be by yourself at that line when the gun goes off, so practice is no different.

quotes.social_post: Kendall Ellis on the importance of a support system: Having a really strong support system of people who aren't involved in the sport is key. Those are your teammates in this at the end of the day.

quotes.speaker: Kendall Ellis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendall Ellis on managing anxiety before a big race
quotes.excerpt: knowing I have anxiety and being aware of that, really affects how I approach meet day

text_blocks.speaker: Kendall Ellis
text_blocks.text: Knowing I have anxiety and being aware of that, really affects how I approach meet day or race day. The night before, I'm trying to put it so far out of my head because the day is going to come regardless. My least favorite thing is when people ask, 'Are you ready?' because the gun's going off whether I'm ready or not.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: What's your thought process, a night before a meet, the morning you wake up? What's your thought process with your mind, with your emotions? What do you do to prepare for those moments because it's completely different than when it comes to basketball and everything else?

quotes.social_post: Kendall Ellis on managing anxiety before a race: My least favorite thing is when people ask are you ready because the gun is going off whether I am ready or not.

quotes.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan on his strict pre-game nap routine
quotes.excerpt: my 17 years in the NBA, I only missed one nap

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: Before noon, no matter what, I have to be asleep. I have to be asleep. My 17 years in the NBA, I only missed one nap. My whole entire career, I missed one nap. So, I have to nap. I'm so superstitious when it comes to naps, so I have to nap.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendall Ellis
text_blocks.text: Oh, you're in like a sleep, you're a slumber.

quotes.social_post: DeMar DeRozan reveals his strict routine: In my 17 years in the NBA I only missed one nap. I am so superstitious when it comes to naps so I have to nap.
